s.t:
We’re looking for a Snr. Product Marketing Manager who’s equal parts strategist, storyteller, and builder. If you’re energized by the idea of shaping how innovative construction tech solutions go to market and you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this might be your next opportunity.
In this role, you will collaborate with marketing, product management, and enablement teams to bring new solutions to market and connect with customers in meaningful ways. Product marketing experience in construction tech is preferred.

Partner with product management to shape needs, positioning and messaging that resonates with real-world users
Identify market trends, collect and synthesize competitive intelligence, and stay close to the customer to uncover opportunities
Define buyer personas, buyer needs, and map the journey from awareness to adoption
Translate technical features into clear, compelling value for our buyers and customers

Own the go-to-market marketing strategy and process for new products and major updates
Support the cross-functional launch planning with sales enablement, product management, and marketing
Create value prop messaging, sales tools, launch content, and campaigns that drive adoption and revenue
Track performance and iterate and optimize

Build feedback loops with customers to inform product and messaging decisions
Collaborate with sales and customer success to surface insights from the field
Contribute to thought leadership and industry conversations-especially in construction tech-through blogs, short-form video, webinars, live- presentations, customer conversations.
Ensure our messaging reflects the real-world challenges and wins of our users

Drive measurable revenue growth through product adoption and usage
Shape how we talk about our products, internally and externally
Bring the voice of the customer into everything we do
Make our team (and our users) smarter with every project you touch

Impact from Day One : You’ll own critical go-to-market initiatives and see your work influence revenue and product strategy.
Growth & Mentorship: Direct exposure to senior leadership, structured learning opportunities, and a clear path for advancement.
Culture of Curiosity: Our team value collaboration, experimentation, and bold thinking. We celebrate wins, learn from failures, and share a passion for transforming how the construction industry works.
A Chance to Shape an Industry: Construction tech is evolving fast. You’ll help define how the market understands and embraces innovation.

Bachelor’s Degree
4+ years in product marketing, product management, or marketing in B2B SaaS
Experience in construction technology, such as estimation, data, project management construction software preferred
Experience leading product launches and working closely with Product teams
Strong writing and storytelling skills, you know how to make complex ideas simple
Pragmatic Marketing certification a plus.

s.h: Curious, collaborative, and always looking for ways to improve
s.t:
Proficiency with marketing tools such as Storylane, Miro, Survicate, Asana, Marketo, Aligned (or Seismic, HighSpot), Pendo (or Gainsight), Chorus (or Gong), AI LLMs (Claude, Co-Pilot ChapGPT), Clay a plus
Up to 15% travel

The salary range for this position (in local currency) is 99,600.00 - 135,00.00

As the Senior Product Marketing Manager for the Sea Domain, you will be the strategic voice of Quantum Systems’ maritime autonomous solutions. You will define and drive the global go-to-market strategy for our Uncrewed Surface Vehicle (USV) and Uncrewed Underwater Vehicle (UUV) portfolios. You will bridge the gap between complex engineering and operational mission effectiveness, ensuring our value propositions resonate with naval operators and defence stakeholders.
Reporting to the Head of Content Creation, you will serve as the domain expert within the Global Marketing team. Your mission is to translate high-end maritime technology into compelling narratives that differentiate Quantum Systems in the global naval market.

s.h: What is your Day to Day Mission
s.t:
Analyze global naval market trends, mission requirements, and competitive developments in close collaboration with Product Management to identify strategic market opportunities for USV and UUV systems.
Develop clear and compelling product positioning, value propositions, and messaging that differentiate our maritime solutions across naval, coast guard, and maritime security applications.
Lead and execute comprehensive Go-to-Market strategies for new product launches, feature releases, and software capabilities in close alignment with Product Management, Engineering, and Sales.
Own the creation of marketing assets, including sales decks, solution briefs, battle cards, white papers and case studies by briefing the content team
Translate complex technical capabilities and maritime scenarios into operational narratives for naval operators and procurement organizations.
Drive market intelligence in collaboration with Product Management by conducting customer surveys and competitive analysis to provide recommendations for marketing.
Establish strong interfaces with Product Management and Engineering to transform technical information into creative, mission-relevant content.
Support the global sales team by providing effective communication materials and product guides for high-stakes procurement processes.
Govern the content roadmap for the Sea Domain, ensuring consistency across all marketing channels, including websites, blog posts, and videos.

s.h: What you bring to the team
s.t:
Extensive experience in strategic product marketing, ideally within the naval, maritime security, or defence technology sector.
Proven track record in developing GTM strategies and positioning complex technical systems for B2B or B2G markets.
High ability to translate sophisticated technology (AI, sensor integration, autonomous systems) into customer benefits.
Strong conceptual skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across international matrix organizations.
High level of ownership and a strategic mindset with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills in German; proficiency in English is a significant advantage.
Domain expertise in maritime operations, including USV/UUV systems, Mine Countermeasures (MCM), Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance (ISR), and Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) would be appreciated.
Understanding of NATO capability development and naval procurement processes would be of help.
Ideally located in Rostock to work closely with the Sea Domain Product Management and operational teams.

Small business owners didn't start their business to become their own bookkeeper, banker, and collections department. Jobber is changing that, building the financial hub for a $400B home-services market, and Fintech is how we get there.

For decades, small businesses ran their finances through a patchwork: a bank for payments, a lender for capital, a spreadsheet for everything else. That's ending. The next generation of financial services won't live at a bank, it'll live inside the software businesses already use to run their day. More and more, vertical SaaS platforms like Jobber won't just help small businesses operate; they'll become their financial hub.
Jobber is building for that world. We already help home service pros get paid faster, secure the capital they need to grow, and see their financial health clearly, and we've only scratched the surface. We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Marketing (Fintech) to own the commercial story that gets us there, as part of our growing Product & Lifecycle Marketing team.

s.h: Here are some of the EXCITING things you’ll get to do
s.t:
Strategy & Planning

· Lead the Pureplay vertical against ambitious growth targets, owning the number and advising the business on how that growth will be unlocked across retail media and trade marketing.

· Lead Retail Media and Trade Marketing strategy and planning for the vertical across the full marketing funnel: setting the standard for what good looks like, guiding your team’s planning, calendar and prioritisation, aligning UKI execution with global objectives, and deploying investment where it drives the strongest commercial return.

· Be the senior, retailer-facing marketing lead for the vertical, building and progressively deepening relationships with the senior marketing contacts within your retailers, and using them to shape joint plans, unlock opportunities and position SharkNinja as a priority partner.

· Act as the sense-check on the viability of what the Strategy, Sales & Analytics (SSnA) and Sales teams propose: probing, collaborating and keeping a helicopter view to ensure full-funnel plans (including promotional and launch events across the year) are joined up, deliver the commercial volume objectives set by SSnA, align to the SKUs and volumes secured by Sales, and keep marketing investment where it needs to be. Develop and own the digital-channel Joint Business Plans with Sales.

· Align plans with the Brand Media and Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) teams to maximise the efficiency and impact of total marketing investment, working with them to adjust plans where necessary due to commercial or operational blocks.

· Champion data- and AI-driven commercial planning to sharpen investment decisions, forecasting and prioritisation.
Commercial, Social & Growth

· Bring a commercial lens to everything the team does, spotting opportunities and gaps, developing retailer campaigns and propositions that turn existing and incremental marketing budget into substantial uplifts in product orders and strong return on investment, and partnering and leading with your Sales counterparts (including the Senior Sales Director, Pureplay) and retailers on these conversations.

· Champion social-first collaborations with our retail partners (influencer, organic social and affiliate), amplified through wider full funnel (on and offsite) retailer-owned media activations to build reach, engagement and conversion.

· Own the digital shelf and content excellence agenda (PDPs, brand stores, search and content) and ensure flawless GTM and NPD support, with assets, listings and launch readiness delivered in time and aligned to launch dates.

· Lead the vertical’s presence at selected physical retailer events, partnering with Retail Excellence (Field & Branded Display) and agencies to deliver brand experiences that add commercial value.
Budget & Performance

· Own your vertical’s multi-million-pound marketing budgets, both contracted A&P (Co-op) and any incremental budget secured, ensuring your team plans and deploys them effectively and adjusting at pace to maximise every pound.

· Set the standard for measurement and reporting, ensuring your team reports spend and performance accurately and on time each week to the Head of Retail Marketing and the wider UKI Leadership team, where it feeds into regional and global visibility.
Leadership & Collaboration

· Lead, motivate and support your team (two Trade Marketing Managers and two Retail Marketing Executives across the five pureplay channels, plus a dotted-line Manager), leading from a place of empathy, owning individual development plans, setting clear objectives and building an unstoppable team.

· Work closely with the other vertical leads, and partner end-to-end with Sales, Brand/Category Marketing, SSnA, Studio, Brand Media, IMC and Retail Excellence (Field & Branded Display) to deliver joined-up, best-in-class activation.

· Act as the bridge between local execution and global strategy, connecting UKI pureplay activity to global brand media workstreams and representing UKI in cross-market and EMEA forums.

· Embody the SharkNinja Outrageously Extraordinary mindset and values, living our leadership principles (including ‘winning is a team sport’), comfortable with ambiguity, energised by rewriting the rule book, and bringing retailers, agencies and colleagues on the journey with you.

· Strong commercial acumen and aptitude with the ability to bring a commercial lens to everything the team does, see the opportunities and the gaps, and partner and lead confidently with Sales counterparts and retailers on commercial conversations.

· Experience in retail, trade or channel marketing, ideally within pureplay, e-commerce or marketplace environments (consumer electronics, FMCG or durable goods a plus).

· Proven brand-side experience, having worked in-house for a brand or manufacturer. Retailer and/or agency background alongside this is welcome and valuable.

· A strong working understanding of full-funnel retail media planning and the digital shelf to enable leading a team of specialists, define what good looks like and challenge the plans guiding where adaptions are needed.

· Proven people-leadership experience: managing, coaching and developing a team with empathy, including building individual development plans that grow your people.

The Solutions Marketing Associate helps Sales create more quality client conversations while delivering fast, polished support for everyday opportunities. This role sits closest to the front end of the sales funnel: helping sellers identify the right accounts, do their homework, personalize outreach, and turn established marketing materials into relevant client-facing presentations.
For standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, the Associate uses existing positioning, narratives, templates, research, case studies, and proof points to efficiently build tailored sales materials without recreating strategy from scratch. At the prospecting stage, the Associate gives sellers the account intelligence and lead development support they need to earn more meetings.
This role builds the intelligence and inputs behind outreach but does not conduct cold calling, prospecting outreach, or appointment setting.
The north star is twofold: help Sales get into more of the right conversations, and help them show up to those conversations prepared.

Prospecting & Meeting Generation Support
Identify and research target accounts that fit priority audiences, verticals, solutions, or seller territories.
Build and maintain actionable lead and account lists with the context sellers need to prioritize outreach.
Research target companies, key contacts, recent business developments, marketing activity, competitive context, and relevant signals that can create a reason to engage.
Prepare concise account briefs and outreach inputs that help sellers personalize emails, calls, and meeting requests.
Connect prospect needs and business signals to relevant Digital Remedy capabilities, proof points, content, and conversation starters.
Partner with Sales on focused prospecting initiatives and campaigns designed to generate qualified meetings.
Track which research, prospecting themes, and materials are helping sellers open doors and use those learnings to improve future support.
Sales Presentations & Everyday Opportunity Support
Support standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, by tailoring existing presentations and materials to the customer and opportunity.
Build polished client-facing decks using established templates, positioning, solution narratives, case studies, research, and proof points.
Quickly identify the most relevant existing materials instead of rebuilding presentations from scratch.
Perform light account, category, audience, or competitive research when needed to make an established story more relevant.
Ensure materials are accurate, on-brand, easy for sellers to present, and aligned with established messaging.
Escalate opportunities that require original research, custom strategy, or a new problem-led narrative to the Solutions Marketing Analyst or Manager.
Sales Alignment & Enablement
Serve as a highly responsive day-to-day partner to Sales, understanding seller priorities, pipeline needs, and recurring friction points.
Help sellers navigate available materials, case studies, research, and solution stories so they can self-serve effectively when appropriate.
Capture recurring requests and content gaps and share them with the Solutions Marketing Manager and Product & Enablement team.
Support broader sales and marketing initiatives that create demand, improve seller preparedness, or accelerate opportunities.
What Success Looks Like
Sellers have a consistent pipeline of well-researched accounts and stronger reasons to reach out.
Prospecting support contributes to more qualified meetings and new sales conversations.
Smaller and standard opportunities receive fast, polished, relevant presentation support without unnecessary custom development.
Sales spends less time searching for materials and researching accounts and more time engaging customers.
The Associate knows when to activate existing materials and when an opportunity should be escalated for deeper strategic support.

1-3 years of experience in sales development, sales support, marketing, research, enablement, account planning, or a coordinator/associate role.
Strong research instincts and genuine curiosity about companies, industries, buyers, and business challenges.
Strong PowerPoint or Google Slides skills and good visual judgment.
Ability to turn research into concise, usable seller talking points and outreach inputs.
Excellent organization and ability to manage multiple fast-turn requests.
A proactive, service-oriented mindset paired with the confidence to ask questions and recommend a better path when needed.
Familiarity with CRM, prospecting, sales intelligence, and research tools is a plus.
Interest in developing toward solutions marketing, insights, strategy, or sales enablement.

Marketing Manager
Remote, South Africa. Full-time, permanent, UK hours. R30,000 per month.
Read this before you apply
This is a senior seat at a company of four people. Nobody will train you and nobody has time to check your work. If you need a manager to break tasks down for you, this is not the job. If you have run the whole marketing channel for a small business and you are good at it, keep reading.
The company
Our client is a London-based AI training and transformation consultancy, a year and a half old, founder-led, growing. They teach leadership teams what AI can actually do for their business, then build it with them: data readiness, workflow analysis, AI literacy training, custom AI agents. Two founders, a small payroll, and a fractional CMO who sets direction.
The job
You run marketing end to end for a small, fast-growing business. The fractional CMO owns the strategy, the calendar and the priorities. Everything downstream of that is yours: you take the brief and you deliver it, properly, without being chased and without being taught.
You will be across all of it, social, content, email, events, analytics, paid. But we are not looking for someone who is average at everything. We want you to be genuinely strong in one or two areas and competent across the rest.
What you will actually do
Take a brief from the fractional CMO and execute it end to end, first time, to a standard nobody has to correct
Build and ship email campaigns and automated sequences in ActiveCampaign, including event follow-up flows segmented by who attended and who did not
Own the content and publishing calendar across LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram
Write. Short-form copy, campaign emails, social, show notes. You will not have a copywriter sitting next to you
Run the SEO programme: what topics the business should own, and the content that wins them
Run and optimise paid campaigns where they earn their place, and report honestly on what they cost and what they returned
Own comms for live events and online workshops, announcement through to post-event follow-up
Keep the tracking honest and produce a monthly report that tells the founders what moved and why
Use AI properly in daily production, not as a novelty
What you need
You have owned marketing end to end at a small business, a startup, or directly for founders. Not a slice of a large corporate marketing department. If your best work was one channel inside a big company, this will not suit you and we would rather say so now
Real depth in one or two areas. SEO and content, or Meta and paid social, or email and lifecycle, or analytics and attribution. Be excellent at something
Numbers you can defend. Not "improved engagement". What was it before, what was it after, what did the business get, and how do you know. You will be asked to walk through a campaign in detail, including what it cost per lead and why that figure is credible
Technical by instinct. You pick up new tools quickly, you have built things yourself, and you use AI because you understand what it can do, not because it is fashionable
You deliver alone. Remote, lightly managed, off a written brief, on time
Experienced enough to have been there and done it. This is not a first or second marketing job

ActiveCampaign specifically, though any serious automation platform transfers
Event marketing
Podcast or video production
Experience marketing a B2B service to business leaders
Two things we will ask you directly
What else are you contracted to do? This is a full-time role and it has to be your only one. We ask everybody, and we ask it first.
Walk me through a campaign you ran, with the numbers. Three of them, with the starting point as well as the finish. If you cannot do that from memory, do not apply yet.
What you get
Full ownership of marketing delivery at a company selling the thing every business is currently trying to work out, with a fractional CMO who knows what he wants and tells you clearly. Full-time, permanent, UK hours, paid in rands into a South African account. Employed through Remote Recruitment , working as part of the client's team.
Equipment
Reliable laptop, stable fibre, quiet professional home working setup.
Process
A recorded screening interview with us, then a task and a final conversation with the founder and the fractional CMO. You will hear back within 24 hours of every stage.
